recommend a new XRP holder do in their first 60 minutes.

---

## 2. The 60-minute setup checklist

1. Buy your wallet from the official source. Never an Amazon reseller.
2. Set up the device offline first. Do not enter your seed phrase on any
   computer, ever.
3. Write your seed phrase / secret numbers on paper, then store the paper
   somewhere fire-safe and out of sight. Do not photograph it.
4. Create a small test transaction (1 XRP) and verify it arrives before
   moving any larger amount.
5. Bookmark only the official wallet URL. Phishing sites are the #1 way
   XRP holders lose funds.

---

## 3. Five mistakes we see new XRP holders make

1. Storing the seed phrase in cloud notes, email, or a password manager.
2. Sending XRP to an exchange without the destination tag.
3. Believing "Ripple" giveaway videos on YouTube. They are all scams.
4. Approving trustlines for unknown tokens — this can authorise spending.
5. Putting the entire portfolio in a single hot wallet on a phone they
   also use for general browsing.
